title: [nana] Fails to build with v141

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

body:
1) `nana\src
ana\include
ana\gui\programming_interface.hpp` line 291 has a non-unicode apostrophe. This creates a large number of warnings (also there is typo).
2) 
```
    #define STRING2(x) #x
    #define SHOW_VALUE(x) " " #x "  =  " STRING2(x) 

    SHOW_VALUE(NANA_WINDOWS)
```

This fails because the MACROS [NANA_WINDOWS, _UNICODE, UNICODE] are defined but have no value.
